resources.string: Syncs backups to and from cloud and network remotes such as S3, WebDAV and SFTP.
Provides POSIX core utilities with consistent options across devices.
Enters the host mount, PID and other namespaces so backups see the real system mounts under root.
Fast Zstandard compression and decompression for archives.
Parallel gzip compression that uses multiple CPU cores.
Encrypts and decrypts backup archives with a symmetric cipher.
Streams files into and out of POSIX tar archives, preserving metadata.
Built-in helper that hashes and copies files, proving the extract-and-exec pipeline works on this device.
